text.en:
Section three of Act Numbered Fifteen hundred and forty-live is hereby amended to read as
"Section 3. The third member of the provincial board shall receive a compensation, to be fixed by resolution
of the provincial board, of not less than five nor more than fifteen pesos for each day of actual attendance at
the sessions of the board. When designated, to perform other official duties as above provided, or when
substituting the provincial governor, in accordance with the provisions of section five of this Act, said third
member shall be entitled, upon the unanimous resolution of the provincial board, to receive for each day that
lie shall be occupied with official duties such compensation as may be fixed in said resolution, not exceeding
the maximum compensation hereinbefore prescribed: Provided, That on no one day shall more than one
compensation he allowed to such third member. The per diem Iked by the provincial board shall not be altered
more than once during each fiscal year."

This Act shall take ollVct on its passage.
Enacted, May 29, 1908.
